title: SweatyPanzer
description:
Nine tanks. Five arenas. One life a round.Round-based 4v4. Two teams start a few hundred metres apart and nobody respawns. Wipe the other side, or take the flag when it goes live near the end of the round. First to four rounds wins. 

Spend between roundsEvery round pays salvage and losing pays more. In the buy window you switch tanks freely and spend across 29 upgrades: gun handling, engine tuning, smoke, a shell booster, an ablative shield. What you buy keeps for the rest of the match.

Angle your armourEvery plate is raked, so a shell that arrives shallow skips off for a fraction of its damage. Turrets and bodies take damage differently. Range bleeds damage off a shell. A T-34's sloped nose turns away shots nothing else can. The gun that bounces off a front plate ends the fight from the flank.

The map is different every timeFive arenas: SIROCCO, BOCAGE, WHITEOUT, MONSOON and RUBBLE. Terrain is generated fresh for each match and shellfire deforms it while you fight.

Ladder and boardsA season ladder ranks you Bronze to Grandmaster, and your tier shows as gold bands on your barrel. Boards rank career score, clutches and longest kill, all time or this week.

Free to playClimb the mastery road, earn titles and medals, and clip your best plays from inside the match.
description_short: Round-based 4v4 tank combat where armour is a decision. Angle your plates, bounce shells, hunt weak zones, and spend salvage between rounds. One life a round, first to four takes the match. Free to play.
